messages:
mali (CS): Crossbeam week0 check-in: running into 2 blockers. 1) KMS key policy denies Redwood role for decrypt; 2) audit logs not forwarding to their Splunk collector. Anyone seen similar? /cc @ethan

ops-bot: deploy-bot: crossbeam/privnet initial infra apply succeeded. 3 hosts up. (CI #4821) :white_check_mark:

ethan (NetOps): looking. can you paste the error from the model-serving logs for KMS decrypt?

mali (CS): Error excerpt from their side (they sent this):
```
AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
```

zoe (Security): Likely key policy missing `AWS::IAM::Role` for redwood-deploy-role. Crossbeam should add this statement. I'll DM policy snippet.

raj (CSE Manager): We should be prescriptive. mali, share small doc with exact policy they need and minimal timestamp for rotation. Also audit log requirements for FedRAMP-ish customers.

mali (CS): Created quick checklist:
- Add redwood-deploy-role ARN to KMS key policy
- Confirm `kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey` permissions
- Ensure CloudWatch Logs -> their Splunk HEC forwarder (port 8088) allowed
- Add S3 bucket arn:aws:s3:::crossbeam-logs to their TLS egress allowlist
I'll paste samples.

ethan (NetOps): For Splunk forwarder, common issue is firewall blocking outbound TLS on custom port. Run from a private agent:
```
curl -v https://splunk-collector.crossbeam.com:8088 -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' -d 'ping'
```

mali (CS): They ran that and got timeout. Network team says egress via NAT gateway not configured for that subnet.

ethan (NetOps): Action: we'll open Egress via NAT in subnet-priv-2a and add route table association. ETA 2 hours. Assigning: @ethan

zoe (Security): Also set audit log retention to 90 days per policy; if they need longer, escalate to compliance. For now set lifecycle on S3 with encryption SSE-KMS.

mali (CS): :thumbsup: I'll send Crossbeam the KMS policy snippet and the curl test they should run after NAT change. Also asking them to confirm the redwood role ARN.

crossbeam-admin (Customer): Thanks — we added the role to the key policy and opened NAT egress. Re-ran curl -> got 200. Next: where to point logs?

mali (CS): Point logs to `https://splunk-collector.crossbeam.com:8088/services/collector/raw` with HEC token (we prefer ephemeral tokens). We'll coordinate rotation within the console.

ops-bot: alert: auth-checker found missing CloudTrail configuration. Please enable org-level CloudTrail for crossbeam account or send s3 bucket for log aggregation.

zoe (Security): We need CloudTrail for audit parity. mali, ask them to create trail with management events (Read/Write) and send S3 ARN. Also ensure log file validation.

crossbeam-admin (Customer): Opened CloudTrail -> logs to s3://crossbeam-redwood-audit. Enabled log file validation. Anything else?

mali (CS): Great. Let's do one more smoke: run an inference request to the private endpoint and verify KMS decrypt works. Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.crossbeam.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
```
If 200 -> we're green.

crossbeam-admin (Customer): Ran it, reply 200, no decrypt errors. Thanks everyone. I'll close this out unless new issues.

raj (CSE Manager): Nice. mali, follow up in 3 days to confirm retention & rotation plan. flag renewal risk if they need >1yr retention (will impact pricing).
